items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: He showed me how to finger that particular passage. He showed me which keys to press down.

ctx.x: Can you tell us a little more about Teo? Did he play clarinet with you at the lessons? Did he have his instrument there to demonstrate, or did he do all of them?
Well, he always had his clarinet alongside him. And there were certain passages that I couldn't finger. He showed me how to finger that particular passage. He showed me which keys to press down.

Nobody seems to ever talk much about his style since he was quite early and didn't do much recording. I think he recorded a little bit with Piron. One of two sides. But what style did he play? What style did he play? Was it more like Noon or? More like Noon. More like than Dodds, I guess.
